title: Free abelian sheaf resolution of a site hypercover
statement: Let $\mathcal D$ be a small site with finite limits [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] [def-weil-size-convention], let $W\in\mathcal D$, and let $V_\bullet\to W$ be an augmented simplicial object [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object]. Put $N_0=W$ and, for $p>0$, let $N_p$ be the finite matching limit in $\mathcal D/W$ of the compatible proper faces of a $p$-simplex. Assume the sieve generated by $V_p\to N_p$ is covering for every $p\geq0$: there is a covering $\{N_{p,k}\to N_p\}_k$ of $\mathcal D$ each member of which factors through $V_p\to N_p$. Let $\mathbf Z[V_p]$ denote the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the free abelian presheaf on the representable $V_p$. Then the augmented alternating-face complex of abelian sheaves $\cdots\to\mathbf Z[V_2]\to\mathbf Z[V_1]\to\mathbf Z[V_0]\to\mathbf Z[W]\to0$ is exact (its degree-zero homology is $\mathbf Z[W]$ and its positive homology sheaves vanish).
